data.name: MainMenu_V1_Description
data.value:
## Supported games From [Imouto Ninshin](https://vndb.org/v2354) to [Netoraren'ai ~Ai Suru Kanojo ga Musunda Midara na Keiyaku~](https://vndb.org/v2354).
## Compatibility * Before [Princess Knight☆Catue ~Ochita Ryuuki Hime~](https://vndb.org/v5067): probably supported, but the engine was still in development, so a lot of stuff probably underwent a lot of changes. * After [Princess Knight☆Catue ~Ochita Ryuuki Hime~](https://vndb.org/v5067): supported, but due to how the engine was developed, which was probably done very poorly, some edge cases might not be fully supported.

data.name: MainMenu_V2_Description
data.value:
## Supported games Everything from [Kangokujou ~Ingyaku no Shihai~](https://vndb.org/v20364).
## Compatibility All of the features are supported, unless a new game has come out that offers a new encryption scheme yet to discover.

data.name: MainMenu_V1_INI_Description
data.value: The initialization file for the game doesn't really do much besides changing the game's title, since we don't have access to any debug feature.

data.name: MainMenu_V1_ODN_Description
data.value: The container files that store all of the game's assets. Some of them are encrypted, and it is hardcoded by what kind of asset they store.
